issues.description: Monkey-patching genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE at import time is exactly the kind of hack that should never land
issues.detail: Reaching into a private attribute of a third-party library at module import time mutates global state for every consumer of google-genai in the process. The comment literally says 'Temporary hack.' Temporary hacks become permanent. Either bump the dep to a version that exposes this as a real config knob, or pass it through a supported API. Refused as-is.

issues.description: image.tobytes() with format="RGB" will produce garbage for any image that isn't already RGB
issues.detail: PIL's Image.open returns whatever mode the source is (RGBA, P, L). Calling .tobytes() without converting to RGB first hands the downstream pipeline raw bytes in the wrong mode while claiming format="RGB". You need image.convert("RGB") before tobytes(), or honor the actual mode. This will break or render corrupted images in production.

issues.description: Three patches submitted as one: image support, default model bump, and dependency upgrades
issues.detail: The diff bundles (1) image generation handling, (2) changing the default model from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash, and (3) a multi-package google dep bump with a constraint-style change from ~= to >=,<. These have independent risk profiles and bisect stories. Split them. THREE-PATCHES.

issues.description: Silent default model change buried under an image-generation PR
issues.detail: Changing the default model is a behavior change for every existing user who didn't pin a model. It belongs in its own commit with its own justification, not as a drive-by in a feature PR titled 'added support for image generation.' Users reading the changelog under 'Added' won't notice their default just shifted.

issues.description: Image-model detection by substring 'image' in model name is fragile
issues.detail: The check `if "image" in self._model_name` will misfire on any future model whose name happens to contain that substring and miss any image model that doesn't. This is a special case where a general capability check (or an explicit allowlist with a TODO to replace it) would be better taste. BAD-TASTE.

issues.description: Gratuitous blank line and no test coverage for the new image path
issues.detail: A stray blank line added after self._http_options in __init__ for no reason. More importantly, there is zero automated test of the inline_data branch in _process_context. The example script is not a test. At minimum a unit test that feeds a fake candidate with inline_data and asserts an OutputImageRawFrame is pushed.

review.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The headline feature is reasonable but the implementation has two real bugs and the PR is the wrong shape. The genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE monkey-patch at import time is a confessed hack against a third-party private attribute and must go. The image.tobytes() call without mode conversion will hand downstream consumers wrong-mode bytes mislabeled as RGB. Beyond that, this is three patches masquerading as one: image support, a silent default-model change, and a multi-package dep bump each deserve their own commit and their own justification. Split it, fix the two bugs, add a unit test for the inline_data branch, and resubmit.
